message: V_what: loc.m=V_m, but the unit has only V_count module(s) (0..V_last)
why: loc.m indexes unit.modules[]. An out-of-range value crashes the diagnostic renderer itself — the loader would fail while trying to report a failure, and you would see a panic instead of this message.
fix: fix loc.m in the producer — this is almost always a frontend bug, not hand-edited IR
or regenerate the IR if it was edited by hand
